key_insight: Random splits reward recall of duplicated perovskite device recipes, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen institutions and future discoveries.
engineering_relevance: Realistic evaluation can help engineers select models for new device designs rather than repeated historical recipes.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Progressively separate duplicate devices, publications, and institutions using grouped splits.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Reliable implementation requires accurate provenance metadata, and the abstract provides no numerical performance margins.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
